instruction: I need to configure my terminal to display the current directory in the window title. Search for how to set PROMPT_COMMAND to update terminal title with current directory and add it to my .bashrc file.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)
